candidate.answerReason: Thirty-six percent of capacity is 45 cups, so one percent is 45 ÷ 36 = 1.25 cups and full capacity is 125 cups.

methods.label: Find one percent first
methods.explanation:
The \(45\) cups represent \(36\%\) of the full capacity. Since \(36\%\) consists of 36 equal one-percent portions, divide by 36 to find the amount corresponding to \(1\%\):
\[
45\div 36=1.25\text{ cups}.
\]
A full coffee maker represents \(100\%\), so it holds
\[
1.25\times 100=125\text{ cups}.
\]
The answer is \(125\) cups, choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
methods.levelReason: The unitary argument uses percentages as equal hundredths, division, and multiplication, all appropriate for AMC 8.

review.mathematicalCheck: Since 36 percent corresponds to 45 cups, one percent corresponds to 45 ÷ 36 = 1.25 cups. Thus 100 percent corresponds to 125 cups. This also satisfies 0.36 × 125 = 45.
